_meta.doc33: §6.4 (the lunar grade), §9.2 (prospect reports), §9.4 (pilot output), §6.8 (hidden files), IV-D9
_meta.author: build, M28.3 (5 Oct 2026): designed per doc 33; anchored to LCROSS's 5.6 ± 2.9% water by weight [A]
_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: Hidden: the true lunar grade and how noisy each prospect is. Read only by src/sim/systems/lunarGeology.ts (which turns it into noisy prospect estimates) and src/sim/systems/act4End.ts (the reveal), plus tests/ and tools/. Never by selectors, the UI during play, or player-like bots.

rich.note: LCROSS-like grades in reachable, shallow deposits at good sites [C/D]

patchy.note: ice in small cold traps, grades varying metre to metre [C]

dry.note: mostly low-grade or deeply buried ice; extraction uneconomic before 2035 [C]

notes: Each site's true resource = the grade's tonnes per site × a per-site factor exp(N(0, site_variance_sd_log)), drawn on its own substream when the site is first claimed (M30). A prospect report = the true value × exp(N(0, sd)) for the report's step (first prospect, second, a pilot that has run two quarters): median-unbiased, narrowing with each step. Pilot output (doc 33 §9.4) = 1.2 t a year per kWe × pilot efficiency 0.3 × pilot_grade_factor (B11).
